# Do not remove virtual-folder view-flag writes based only on an apparently invalid getter

D209493 author found gViewWrapper.viewFlags undefined and removed a virtual-folder dbView.viewFlags assignment as dead code. Bug 1905912 later traced a user-visible regression to Bug 1895097: after Grouped By Sort on unified inbox, switching folders and returning showed unthreaded view. The July 2024 correction restored the assignment using gViewWrapper._viewFlags in both grouped and ungrouped sort paths. In D215499 the author said a back-end persistence fix might be better long term, but this front-end fix had less risk for ESR 128. A new browser_groupedBySortPersistence.js test checks single- and multi-folder virtual views by changing folders and returning. The test comment says front-end transitions need coverage beyond unit tests that only set DBViewWrapper properties. Current code still writes dbView.viewFlags for virtual folders. The old getter was wrong, but the write itself had an effect.

Scope: Thread pane and DBViewWrapper.

Paths:

- `mail/base/content/about3Pane.js`
